title: Kanom Buang (Thai Crêpes)
description: Kanom Buang is a traditional Thai crêpe dessert filled with a sweet coconut and bean paste. Serve with a sprinkle of powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: Kanom buang dough (or substitute with plain flour)

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the kanom buang dough ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of the batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the crêpe with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook for another minute until the other side is lightly browned.
Repeat with the remaining batter to make 8-10 crêpes.
To make the filling, combine the coconut milk, bean paste, and powdered sugar in a small bowl.
Mix well until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the vegetable oil, dehydrated coconut, and lightly sweetened coconut flakes to the filling mixture.
To assemble the Kanom Buang, place a tablespoon of the filling mixture onto the center of a crêpe.
Fold the bottom half of the crêpe up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the crêpe to form a tight cylinder.
